verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs explicitly describe Funnels for measuring conversion drop-off across event series (mixpanel-docs-2), with filtering/breakdown support via properties and cohorts (mixpanel-docs-16) and the Query API's ability to 'Filter or break down Events' (mixpanel-docs-39). Community commentary corroborates Mixpanel's flow/funnel analysis as a standout capability praised by PMs for quickly generating custom reports (mixpanel-comm-12, mixpanel-comm-15). Missing for 10: a dedicated deep-dive doc on funnel breakdown UI mechanics and more recent independent hands-on validation specifically of the Funnels report (vs. the older Flow feature).
